issues.problem: Embedding bundled JavaScript with String.replace interpreted dollar sequences as replacement syntax, preventing module execution.
issues.fix: Use callback replacements for exact literal content; validate the extracted inline module with node --check.

issues.problem: A rejected WebGPU pipeline could leave r180 compileAsync unresolved and prevent ready.
issues.fix: Propagate the engine promise rejection and recover to WebGL 2 on a replacement canvas, with bounded preparation time.

issues.problem: Animation overwrote the base scale of motes, particles and the contact shadow, producing large discs.
issues.fix: Retain base effect scales and multiply their animation factors.

issues.problem: A previous gameplay toast and room banner briefly showed through the title.
issues.fix: Hide transient gameplay overlays explicitly on return to title.

reviewFindingsAlsoVerified: Developer free flight initially retained solid collisions; it now uses a sensor collider until reset.
Mouse motion now exits attract mode and updates the active input prompts.
Long-fall score penalties and footstep sounds are implemented and verified.
